# Version 4.150.2
> **Skia m150 correctness fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes Skia m150 with GPU and shader correctness fixes. The servicing update prevents stale Ganesh readbacks, restores resolve-task dirty tracking, and fixes a SkSL RasterPipeline use-after-free.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Skia m150 rendering correctness improved** — Refreshes the bundled engine with fixes for failed Ganesh flushes, stale texture readbacks, resolve-task dirty tracking, Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion, and a SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

Co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2, advancing from 14.2.1.1 with no HarfBuzz-specific product changes in this scope.
